name: Sea Suite
summary: Spacious suite with open sea views and a bath by the window.
description: The largest suite in the house, with open sea views from the bed and a freestanding bathtub by the window to watch the evening fall. Original clay floors, high ceilings and a sitting area with armchairs facing the water. The king bed and linen invite you to stay; the bathroom adds a rain shower. For a couple's escape with no clock.
